summary: Iteration 173 — Devices Command Center (Fleet Pulse v1). Backend: 17/17 pytest passed for all 11 endpoints (pulse, risk-heatmap, lifecycle, top-risks, anomalies, activity-ticker, top-talkers, offline-watch, saved-views CRUD, quick-scripts catalog+run+404+400, tags ok+400+404). Frontend: Pulse is the default tab, ActivityTicker shows LIVE, TopRisksStrip renders 2 cards (risk-offline, risk-predict), all 4 tabs render correctly, fleet-pulse-wall renders 135 pulse-tile-* cards with sparklines, anomaly-inbox visible, Insights tab shows top-talkers (cpu/ram/disk) + risk-heatmap-canvas + lifecycle-timeline, Directory tab shows saved-views-bar + density toggles + device-search + 135 status-orbs. Saved view create works end-to-end. '/ticket TECH' in device-search correctly routes to /tickets?device_id=<id>&new=1. Bulk Quick Script: selecting rows reveals bulk-quick-script-btn, dialog lists 11 quick-script rows, clicking run-quick-script-qs-cleanup-temp queues script and shows toast 'Queued Cleanup Temp Files for 2 device(s)'. Cmd+K opens device-command-palette and ESC closes it. 0 console errors during testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Ctrl+K opens TWO command palettes simultaneously — the new DeviceCommandPalette AND the global app-shell command palette. The global palette's DialogOverlay (z-50 fixed inset-0 bg-black/80) sits above the new palette and intercepts pointer events, so the device palette's input cannot be focused/typed into via mouse and palette-suggestion-* never renders. Typing 'TECH' or 'reboot TECH' via keyboard returned 0 suggestions. ESC closes both at once which masks the conflict.

Clicking data-testid="density-dense" does not visibly change row height (measured tr bounding-box stayed at 40px before and after). The buttons exist and are clickable but the height class/state change is not propagating to <tr> rows. Either the density state is not wired to the table rows, or the dense class is being overridden.

Component returns null when the offline-watch API has 0 results (no devices went offline in last 15 min). The spec lists offline-watch as 'visible in the right column' — at minimum it should render an empty/idle state (e.g. 'No recent offline events') so the right column feels populated and the testid is always assertable.

issues: Right column under Pulse only shows AnomalyInbox when offline-watch is empty, making the column look light. Consider always rendering OfflineWatch with an empty state.

TopRisksStrip rendered only 2 of the possible 5 callouts in demo data — this is correct given the data, but worth seeding 'risk-disks' / 'risk-ram' / 'risk-patches' fixtures so QA reliably covers all 5 templates.

action_items: Fix Ctrl+K conflict: when on /devices, either suppress the global command palette or have DeviceCommandPalette claim the shortcut (stopPropagation + capture-phase). Right now the global palette's overlay blocks all clicks/typing in the device palette making palette-suggestion-* unreachable via mouse.
Wire density-compact / density-dense state to the actual table row classes (currently buttons toggle but tr heights stay 40px).
Render OfflineWatch even when list is empty (idle state) so the right column under Pulse never collapses.
critical_code_review_comments: device_pulse.py: _sparkline is fully deterministic from device_id+salt — values never change between calls so the 'live' sparkline is actually static. Either re-seed with a time bucket (e.g. salt += hour) or persist last 24 polls in a small ring collection. Right now refreshing /devices/pulse gives identical arrays, which contradicts the 'live telemetry' framing.
device_pulse.py imports `random as _r` and instantiates `_rand = _r.Random()` but never uses it — dead code, remove.
device_pulse.py uses md5 for hashing — fine for non-security pseudo-random but consider hashlib.blake2b which is faster and not flagged by security scanners.

DevicesPage.jsx is now wiring 13+ new sub-components and likely well over 900 lines. Consider extracting Pulse / Insights / Directory tab bodies into their own files (DevicesPulseTab.jsx, DevicesInsightsTab.jsx, DevicesDirectoryTab.jsx) — DRY/file-size guideline says >700 lines should split.

DeviceCommandPalette listens for window 'keydown' Ctrl+K with preventDefault but the global command palette likely uses the same listener — they currently both fire. Wrap the device listener so it only activates when route starts with /devices AND the global one is not already open, or add e.stopImmediatePropagation() once the device palette opens.

rca_of_the_issue: Cmd+K double-palette: both DeviceCommandPalette.jsx (lines 54-64) and the global app-shell command palette register a window keydown listener for (metaKey||ctrlKey)+k. Neither stops propagation, so both setOpen(true) fire. The global palette renders second/higher in the DOM tree, placing its Radix DialogOverlay over the device palette's input. Fix: in DeviceCommandPalette useEffect, after setOpen(o=>!o), call e.stopImmediatePropagation(), OR gate the global palette listener with `if (location.pathname.startsWith('/devices')) return;`. Density toggle: density state likely lives in DevicesPage but tr rows render from a child table component that doesn't receive the density prop — verify the prop drilling or context binding.
